shadows.name: pressed-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover feedback paired with physical translation.

motion.name: results-fade
motion.purpose: Fade and 12px upward entrance for generated results.

motion.name: spinner
motion.purpose: Loading indicator rotation; reduced-motion preferences collapse animation duration.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width purple generation action with physical pressed feedback.
components.css: .ds-generate { width: 100%; padding: 0.95rem 1.25rem; border: 3px solid #17151b; border-radius: 0; background: #c6b0f7; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #17151b; color: #17151b; font-family: Tajawal, sans-serif; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease; } .ds-generate:hover { transform: translate(3px, 3px); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #17151b; } .ds-generate:active { transform: translate(4px, 4px); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #17151b; } .ds-generate:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #7651bc; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Theme Button
components.description: Compact mint theme control with a bordered circular indicator.
components.css: .ds-theme { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem; border: 3px solid #17151b; border-radius: 0; background: #aee0c1; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #17151b; color: #17151b; font-family: Tajawal, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease; } .ds-theme-dot { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; border: 2px solid #17151b; border-radius: 50%; background: #17151b; } .ds-theme:hover { transform: translate(3px, 3px); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #17151b; } .ds-theme:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #7651bc; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: API Key Button
components.description: Compact header control that opens the key dialog and turns mint when a key is ready.
components.css: .ds-key { padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem; border: 3px solid #17151b; border-radius: 0; background: #f6db75; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #17151b; color: #17151b; font-family: Tajawal, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease; } .ds-key[data-has-key="true"] { background: #aee0c1; } .ds-key:hover { transform: translate(3px, 3px); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #17151b; } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #7651bc; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: API Key Dialog
components.description: Square cream credential sheet with hard offset, masked key field, and memory-only actions.
components.html: مفتاح Gemini
components.css: .ds-key-dialog { width: min(32rem, calc(100vw - 2rem)); padding: 1.5rem; border: 3px solid #17151b; border-radius: 0; background: #fffaf0; box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 #17151b; color: #17151b; } .ds-key-dialog::backdrop { background: rgba(23, 21, 27, 0.55); } .ds-key-dialog h2 { font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 900; } .ds-key-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.75rem; }

components.name: API Key Input
components.description: Masked LTR monospace credential field with cream paper and hard black frame.
components.html: <input class="ds-key-input" type="password" dir="ltr" autocomplete="off" placeholder="الصق مفتاح Gemini هنا">
components.css: .ds-key-input { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 0.85rem; border: 3px solid #17151b; border-radius: 0; outline: none; background: #fffaf0; box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #17151b; color: #17151b; direction: ltr; font-family: monospace; text-align: left; } .ds-key-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #7651bc; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Suggestion Chip
components.description: Clickable project-description suggestion with a hard pill silhouette.
components.css: .ds-suggestion { padding: 0.45rem 0.85rem; border: 2px solid #17151b; border-radius: 999px; background: #f6db75; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #17151b; color: #17151b; font-family: Tajawal, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease; } .ds-suggestion:hover { transform: translate(3px, 3px); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #17151b; } .ds-suggestion:active { transform: translate(4px, 4px); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #17151b; } .ds-suggestion:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #7651bc; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Project Textarea
components.description: Large RTL writing field with a cream surface and hard black frame.
components.html: <textarea class="ds-project" rows="4" dir="rtl" placeholder="اكتب هنا فكرة مشروعك، ما الذي تبيعه؟ ومن هم عملاؤك؟"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-project { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 11rem; resize: vertical; padding: 1.1rem; border: 3px solid #17151b; border-radius: 0; outline: none; background: #fffaf0; box-shadow: 7px 7px 0 #17151b; color: #17151b; caret-color: #7651bc; font-family: Tajawal, sans-serif; font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.9; } .ds-project::placeholder { color: #62546b; opacity: 1; } .ds-project:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #7651bc; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Slogan Result Card
components.description: Yellow generated-output card with heavy Arabic slogan typography.
components.html:
الشعار اللفظي

من البيت… نكهة تجمعنا
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 16rem; padding: 1.5rem; border: 3px solid #17151b; border-radius: 0; background: #f6db75; box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 #17151b; color: #17151b; font-family: Tajawal, sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 1.5rem; font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 900; } .ds-card p { flex: 1; margin: 0 0 1.5rem; font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.65; } .ds-card button { align-self: flex-start; padding: 0.4rem 1.1rem; border: 2px solid #17151b; border-radius: 0; background: #fffaf0; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #17151b; color: #17151b; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; } .ds-card button:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 #17151b; } .ds-card button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #7651bc; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Color Swatch
components.description: Circular dynamic color sample paired with its Arabic name and LTR HEX code.
components.css: .ds-color { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; min-width: 15rem; padding: 1rem; border: 3px solid #17151b; background: #f4b8c8; color: #17151b; font-family: Tajawal, sans-serif; } .ds-swatch { width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; border: 3px solid #17151b; border-radius: 50%; background: #8a4b2f; } .ds-color strong { overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-weight: 800; } .ds-color code { font-family: monospace; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview: The interface feels like a generous sheet of colored working paper: direct Arabic typography, visible black construction lines, and controls that behave like physical stamps. It is playful without becoming decorative, and keeps the generation task ahead of visual ornament.
keyCharacteristics: Native Arabic RTL composition with Tajawal typography.
Cream paper ground and distinct pastel working surfaces.
Sharp black borders and solid offset shadows with no blur.
Buttons physically move down and right when pressed.
Result cards stay light and readable in dark mode.

rules.name: The Light Cards Rule
rules.body: Keep all three identity cards on their yellow, pink, and mint surfaces in both themes; only the shell and writing field darken.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Reserve purple for the main generation button so the page has one obvious primary action.

rules.name: The ID Selector Rule
rules.body: Hero, result-heading, and card-heading typography uses component-specific selectors so runtime-injected Tailwind preflight cannot reset their size or weight.

rules.name: The Hard Depth Rule
rules.body: Never add blur to component shadows; use opaque black offsets only.

rules.name: The Physical Press Rule
rules.body: Hover-capable controls translate by `3px` on both axes while their shadow contracts; active state moves slightly farther.

dos: Do preserve native RTL reading order and test both narrow and wide layouts.
Do keep generated Arabic text in `textContent` or form-field values.
Do keep printable result surfaces colored with exact print-color adjustment.
Do provide reduced-motion behavior and visible keyboard focus.
donts: Don't use blurred shadows or rounded cards.
Don't darken the three generated result cards with the shell theme.
Don't let Tailwind preflight flatten component heading typography.
Don't introduce additional accents where the established pastel role already exists.
